label: Facebook & Instagram Shops
terms_note: Meta developer app + Business verification; permissions catalog_management and commerce_account_manage_orders / read_orders need App Review for use on other businesses' assets (our multi-tenant case); Commerce Manager account per tenant; Meta commerce policies on products; Graph API rate limits per app / business (BUC); the permission + review pages themselves were not reachable in this pass (404).

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Meta app + Business login / system-user token with catalog_management + commerce_account_* permissions)

auth: 1. Create a Meta app (Business type); request catalog_management, commerce_account_manage_orders, commerce_account_read_orders, business_management.
2. Complete Business verification + App Review for the permissions (multi-tenant use).
3. Tenant connects through Facebook Login for Business / Commerce onboarding; store the long-lived or system-user token per tenant.
4. Read the user's Commerce Manager account (cms_id) and catalog id.

endpoints.purpose: create / update products, price, availability, inventory
endpoints.notes: retailer_id, name, description, price, availability, inventory, image_url, url, brand, condition
CSV / TSV / XML feed at a URL
states FB_PROCESSING, CREATED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED; fields id, order_status, created, last_updated; cursor pagination

endpoints.call: Returns API · Shipping Profiles API · Order Snapshot API
endpoints.purpose: returns, carrier / rate settings, unified updates

reference.limits: Graph API business-use-case rate limits per app / per business (not restated on the pages opened). - Meta Platform Terms + Commerce policies; App Review + Business verification for the commerce permissions on third-party assets. - Checkout on Facebook & Instagram is being replaced by offsite checkout per the overview — order APIs apply only to shops that still check out on Meta. - Product data must satisfy catalog specs (feed / batch validation).

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: System-user (or long-lived user) access token of a Meta app with catalog_management and, for orders, commerce_account_manage_orders / commerce_account_read_orders permissions on the commerce account; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

config_fields.name: catalog_id
config_fields.help: Product catalog id (Commerce Manager > Catalog > Settings).

config_fields.name: cms_id
config_fields.help: Commerce account (CMS) id; required for list_orders.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: ISO currency of the catalog prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price ('9.99 USD').

adapter.terms: Meta Graph API (Commerce Platform + Catalog Batch API). Catalog batch requests are processed asynchronously; the returned handle can be polled at GET /{catalog_id}/check_batch_request_status?handle=…

me.note: Reads the configured product catalog {id, name, product_count} to verify the token and catalog access.

update_listing.note: items_batch UPDATE for one PRODUCT_ITEM: `listing_id` is the item's retailer id (data.id); price is sent as '<amount> <currency>' using the currency config field; quantity maps to quantity_to_sell_on_facebook. Changes go LIVE on Facebook/Instagram shops once processed; raw.handles[0] is the batch handle and raw.validation_status lists per-item errors.

set_inventory.note: items_batch UPDATE {id: sku, quantity_to_sell_on_facebook}: `sku` is the retailer id of the catalog item (required).

end_listing.note: items_batch DELETE removes the item (retailer id = listing_id) from the catalog and therefore from Shops and catalog ads; not reversible (re-create it to restore).

list_orders.note: GET /{cms_id}/commerce_orders?state (FB_PROCESSING|CREATED|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, comma-separated; default CREATED). `since` is not applied because updated_after is a Unix timestamp. Pagination is by Graph cursors (raw paging), so only the first page is returned; amounts are in raw.estimated_payment_details. New orders must be acknowledged (POST /{order_id}/acknowledge_order) before fulfilment; not done here.

mark_shipped.note: Attach Shipment POST /{order-id}/shipments {idempotency_key, tracking_info: {carrier, tracking_number}}; items are omitted, so 'all unfulfilled quantities of items on the order' are shipped. When sending tracking_info both carrier and tracking_number are required.

not_offered.create_listing: A PRODUCT_ITEM CREATE needs link, image_link, brand, condition and availability besides id/title/description/price; the vocabulary has no product page link, brand or condition.
